title: Draft and past-date recovery
preconditions: Ability to use localStorage draft and past-date recovery UI. May require setting visit date to a past day after save, or using recovery entry points the app provides.
dateUnderTest: Start future; then exercise past recovery.
cleanup: `npm run clear:itinerary` + clear itinerary-config if sticky.

steps.name: Mid-wizard draft
steps.do: Start builder, set date, select animals; do not finish.

steps.name: Trigger past-date recovery
steps.do: Cause past-date recovery (set visit date in the past if UI allows, or open app when saved date is past).

steps.name: Removed-items popup
steps.do: Review animals added/removed, talks unavailable, times adjusted, etc.

steps.name: Alternate clear path
steps.do: On another run, choose clear itinerary from recovery if available.

steps.name: Don’t show again
steps.do: If suppression checkbox exists, note behavior.
